name: Projected Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension / Projected Recursive Teaching Dimension
details: Positivity is a restriction of recursive teaching on every coordinate trace.
witness_verification: For every n >= 4, the database-owned values 1129 and 1137 give positive projected RTD n-1 and ordinary projected RTD 3. The ratio (n-1)/3 tends to infinity, excluding every reverse affine bound. The endpoint proofs use the intersection-closure identity and the explicit order scheme; sync/verify_singleton_cosingleton.py replays the finite controls.
proof: For every S, $\mathrm{RTD}^{+}(\mathcal H_{|S})\geq\mathrm{RTD}(\mathcal H_{|S})$. Maximize both sides over S.
